input.expected_problem: Bot may get confused by caller who changes their mind mid-conversation

conversation.content: Hello, this is Monica at Demo Clinic Alpha. How can I help you?
Hi, I think I need to schedule an appointment.
Sure! What would the appointment be for?
Actually, wait. Before I do that - do you know if my lab results are back? I had blood work last week.
I can help you check on that. Were you feeling anxious about the results?

Oh, not really anxious, just curious. I just want to know if everything is okay. But, hmm, actually never mind the labs. Let me just schedule the appointment. But wait—what are your hours? I need to figure out when I can come in.
Our office hours are Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday from 9 AM to 1 PM. We're closed on Sundays. Is there anything else I can help with?
Okay, so you're open until 5. That might work. Actually, can I check on those lab results first after all? Then I'll know if I even need to come in.
Got it! I can help you check on that. Just to confirm, you had blood work done last week, right?
Yes, that's right! But, okay, actually, I changed my mind. I do want to schedule that appointment either way. Sorry, I know I'm all over the place today.
No problem at all! What would the appointment be for?
I’m not sure yet, but I think it might be for a follow-up regarding my lab results. Can we check those results first, and then I’ll decide what kind of appointment I need?
I understand. Let me get you to someone who can look that up for you. Just a moment!
Thank you! I appreciate your help. Sorry for the back and forth!
